license_status: unresolved; local integration only, not cleared for public release
adaptations: EDC-prepared original RGB images and explicit multi-view mappings feed an isolated worker without research-repository imports or machine-specific paths. Fixed FPS, equal view counts and source/playback equality are not input gates.

GRM image prompts, progress scoring and existing attribution rules retain their method identity. Checkpoint-declared embedding/output-head sharing is respected through instance-local vLLM configuration.

Recorded source time drives duration windows, physical derivatives, segmentation mappings and the explicitly selected training_filter_v8. Sample-count rules and numerical thresholds retain their meanings.
Subtask intervals use explicit playback/source seconds or half-open reference-frame ranges. Missing reliable time permits visual progress only.

Native subtask outputs, text reports, progress plots and optional sampled review videos preserve AFTER-frame identity. Run-owned image caches may be cleaned after normal completion while source mappings and RGB hashes remain.
Physical evidence uses robot metadata and explicitly identified load proxies. Grippers support confirmed open/closed references or the native scalar relative-opening rule on declared units.

Fixed current rules use declared amperes directly; baseline, standard deviation and percentiles remain algorithm estimates. Torque requires explicit N*m thresholds and does not enable current-based proactive or v8 rules.

Explicit conditional attribution may retain documented pending assumptions, but cannot complete assessment or enable filtering. Full assessment requires segmentation, visual coverage, physical evidence and the selected filtering branch; incomplete attribution retains its visual evidence.
